_comment: L2 contract for known folders (knaif.known_folders): an output that names Downloads, Desktop, Documents, Pictures, Music, Videos or home goes into the user's real folder, resolved by code and never by the model. `named` cases: which known folder a path value starts with (null for none). `destination` cases: whether a request names a known folder as where something goes, the gate of the known-folder prompt examples. `rewrite` cases: given a plan, folders that exist (relative to the working folder) and an optional sandbox, the plan after the rewrite, a clarify, or a refusal; <known> stands for the folder KNAIF_KNOWN_FOLDERS_ROOT points at, and <work> for the working folder. Consumed by python/core/tests/test_known_folder_parity.py; the native consumer comes with the native mirror.
_expected_values: Produced by the reference runtime (knaif.known_folders). DO NOT regenerate to make a failing test pass.

destination.text: extract the audio as mp3 into my Music folder
convert clip.mov to mp4, output to Documents
put an mp4 version of clip.mov in my Downloads folder
delete everything in my videos folder
convert all the clips in my Videos folder to mp4
make a webm of clip.mp4 in my Downloads folder

rewrite.name: a_same_named_folder_in_the_working_folder_asks
rewrite.expected_clarify: There is a Downloads folder at <work>/Downloads, and your Downloads folder is <known>/Downloads. Which one should I save into?

rewrite.name: a_same_named_folder_next_to_the_input_does_not_ask
rewrite._comment: A relative output is under the working folder, never the input's, so only a same-named folder there is a question (owner, 2026-10-24).

rewrite.name: the_question_names_the_folder_as_the_plan_spells_it
rewrite._comment: The plan's spelling first, then the display name (2026-10-24). Python looped over the two as a set, so on a case-insensitive disk, where both are folders, the question named either.
rewrite.expected_clarify: There is a videos folder at <work>/videos, and your Videos folder is <known>/Videos. Which one should I save into?

rewrite.name: a_local_folder_that_holds_the_inputs_is_the_one_meant
rewrite._comment: Owner, 2026-10-25:'convert the mov files in videos to mp4 into a folder called small' plans videos/*.mov -> videos/small. The inputs are in the local videos folder, so that is the folder meant: the output stays there, and nothing asks.
